description: Source code for hardware info driver specific to MCUX RCM, handling reset cause translation and retrieval.

methods.name: hwinfo_mcux_rcm_xlate_reset_sources
methods.description: Translates MCUX RCM reset source bitmask to Zephyr hwinfo reset source bitmask.

methods.name: z_impl_hwinfo_get_reset_cause
methods.description: Retrieves the reset cause by reading RCM reset sources and translating them.

methods.name: z_impl_hwinfo_clear_reset_cause
methods.description: Clears the sticky reset sources in RCM.

methods.name: z_impl_hwinfo_get_supported_reset_cause
methods.description: Retrieves supported reset causes from RCM and translates them.
